description_en: Queries the health check status of a Network Load Balancer (NLB) listener
description_zh: 查询网络型负载均衡实例监听的健康检查状态
kebab_example: aliyun nlb get-listener-health-status --listener-id lsn-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000@80 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetListenerHealthStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the listener on the NLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 网络型负载均衡实例的监听ID
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the NLB instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

schema.description_en: The health check status of the listener
schema.description_zh: 查询监听健康检查状态

ListenerHealthStatus.description_en: The health check status of the server group of the listener
ListenerHealthStatus.description_zh: 监听的服务器组健康检查状态列表

items.description_en: The health check status of the server group of the listener
items.description_zh: 监听的服务器组健康检查状态列表

ListenerId.description_en: The ID of the listener of the NLB instance
ListenerId.description_zh: 网络型负载均衡实例的监听ID

ListenerProtocol.description_en: The listening protocol. Valid values: TCP, UDP, and TCPSSL

ServerGroupInfos.description_en: The information about the server groups

items.description_en: The information about the server group

HeathCheckEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the health check feature is enabled. Valid values:

true: enabled
false: disabled
HeathCheckEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启健康检查。取值：

true：开启。

false：关闭

NonNormalServers.description_en: A list of unhealthy backend servers
NonNormalServers.description_zh: 非正常状态的后端服务器列表

items.description_en: A list of unhealthy backend servers
items.description_zh: 非正常状态的后端服务器列表

Reason.description_en: The cause of the health check failure

ReasonCode.description_en:
The reason why the status is abnormal. Valid values:

CONNECT_TIMEOUT: The NLB instance failed to connect to the backend server within the specified period of time.
CONNECT_FAILED: The NLB instance failed to connect to the backend server.
RECV_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT: The NLB instance failed to receive a response from the backend server within the specified period of time.
CONNECT_INTERRUPT: The connection between the health check and the backend servers was interrupted.
HTTP_CODE_NOT_MATCH: The HTTP status code from the backend servers was not the expected one.
HTTP_INVALID_HEADER: The format of the response from the backend servers is invalid
ReasonCode.description_zh:
Status为异常状态时的详细原因。取值：

CONNECT_TIMEOUT：负载均衡健康检查时向后端服务器建立连接超时。
CONNECT_FAIL：负载均衡健康检查时向后端服务器建立连接失败。
RECV_TIMEOUT：负载均衡健康检查时从后端服务器接收响应超时。
CONNECT_INTERRUPT：负载均衡健康检查与后端服务器连接中断。
HTTP_CODE_NOT_MATCH：负载均衡健康HTTP检查时从后端服务器接收的响应码与预期配置返回码不一致。
HTTP_INVALID_HEADER：负载均衡健康HTTP检查时从后端服务器接收响应格式错误

ServerId.description_en: The ID of the backend server

ServerIp.description_en: The IP address of the backend server

Status.description_en:
The health check status. Valid values:

Initial: indicates that health checks are configured for the NLB instance, but no data was found.
Unhealthy: indicates that the backend server consecutively fails health checks.
Unavailable: indicates that health checks are disabled
Status.description_zh:
健康检查状态。取值：

Initial：初始化中，表示负载均衡实例配置了健康检查，但查不到数据。

Unhealthy：异常，表示连续上报不健康的状态。

Unavailable：未开启，表示未开启健康检查

ServerGroupId.description_en: The ID of the server group

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, it indicates that no next query is to be sent.
If a value of NextToken is returned, the value is the token used for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
